card.name: Inside interleukin and split long words
card.fires_on: The final piece of the word interleukin, just before a hyphen and a number such as -1, -2, -6 or -15. It also fires on a few other words broken mid-way, like anec-dot-ally.

modes.description: The 'in' ending of interleukin, right before a hyphen and the number naming the interleukin.
